name: FileStatus
description:
The FileStatus component shows the status of a file during processing: the status icon, the file name, its progress and status text, and an action button that cancels, retries or deletes the file.

`<FileStatus>` renders the whole card from `file`, `now` and `status` (`processStatus.TODO`, `PROCESSING`, `DONE` or `ERROR`) and calls `onClick` with the action for the status. Direct part children override that part, e.g. `<FileStatus.Action aria-describedby="…" />` or `<FileStatus.StatusText>Envoyé</FileStatus.StatusText>`, or compose the primitives for full structural control.

parts.name: El
parts.description: Renders the status icon, file name, progress bar, status text and action button for `status`; direct part children override that part, other children render at the end of the info column

props.name: id
props.description: A unique identifier for the file status. Required for accessibility.

props.name: file
props.description: The name of the file.

props.name: now
props.description: The percentage of the file that has been processed.

props.name: status
props.description: The status of the file.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when a user clicks the action button at the end of the card, with the action for the current status: `cancel`, `retry` or `delete`.

parts.name: Progress
parts.description: A small `ProgressBar` labelled "File upload status"; `id`, `label` and `now` are optional

props.name: id
props.description: A unique identifier for the progress bar. Generated when omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: The progress bar's accessible label.

props.name: now
props.description: The percentage processed.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows an indeterminate bar instead of `now`.

parts.name: Action
parts.description: An IconButton that cancels (`todo`, `processing`), retries (`error`) or deletes (`done`), with the matching icon, label and palette

props.name: status
props.description: The status the action applies to: it picks the default icon, label and palette. `<FileStatus>` supplies it to a patch child.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The accessible label. Defaults to "Cancel", "Retry" or "Delete" for the status.

props.name: children
props.description: The icon. Defaults to the Cerberus `close`, `redo` or `delete` icon for the status.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The card: a row with the status icon, the info column and the action button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.

parts.description: Holds the status icon (an Avatar with a status gradient).
